name: Starship

source.title: Pathfinder rules text (Foundry PF2E trait descriptions)

text: Starships are massive space-worthy objects capable of transporting creatures and cargo across great distances. Creatures with the starship trait are massive creatures that have adapted to survive in space. Hazards with this trait are triggered during starship encounters. Actions, spells, or other abilities with the starship trait are intended to be used in tactical starship combat against threats on the sensor map. Creatures and objects with the starship trait can generally only be damaged or otherwise affected by actions, creatures, and items with the starship trait.
